verdict.rationale: PayPal documents multiple concrete onboarding paths (Agent Ready for Braintree merchants, ACP/UCP checkout builds, Store Sync catalog feeds, cart API endpoints), but its own docs state access to agentic commerce services is 'form-gated, not self-serve' requiring PayPal AI team follow-up, UCP requires separate Google merchant registration, and Agent Ready requires an existing Braintree account rather than a simple toggle or agreement. Missing for 10: a true self-serve enable/agree/publish flow without approval gating, and evidence of turnaround time or automatic activation.
